Topics · Meaning and purpose

If we are animals, why is human life sacred?

In the Quran worth is a gift, not an ability: honour for all, one life weighed as all, a breath of spirit.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:70

Translation

what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him? For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor. You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

Original · Hebrew

מָֽה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן־אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ׃ וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃ תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־רַגְלָֽיו׃

the Psalms · 8:4-6

World English Bible

Try the usual answers. If a life is worth what it can do, the sick, the old and the newborn are worth less. If it is worth what it can feel or think, a person in a coma is worth less. Most of us refuse that at once. A person's worth does not rise and fall with ability. Then where does it come from? The verse says honour was given to all the children of Adam. No one earned it, so no one loses it by falling ill.

A question for you

What do you think gives a person their worth?

If you sayWhat they can do.
ThenThen ask what follows for those who can do little. The verse starts somewhere else.
If you sayThat they can feel and think.
ThenThat is a serious answer, and it struggles with those who cannot yet, or can no longer.
If you sayThat they are loved.
ThenThen what of someone no one loves? The honour in the verse does not wait for anyone's love.
If you sayNothing objective. We simply agree on it.
ThenThen worth rests on agreement, and the verse offers another footing: honour given to all.

Part 2 of 3

﴿مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنَّهُۥ مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًۢا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَآ أَحْيَا ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَمُسْرِفُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Because of that, We decreed upon the Children of Israel that whoever kills a soul unless for a soul[258] or for corruption [done] in the land[259] - it is as if he had slain mankind entirely. And whoever saves one[260] - it is as if he had saved mankind entirely. And Our messengers had certainly come to them with clear proofs. Then indeed many of them, [even] after that, throughout the land, were transgressors.[261]

Translator's notes

[258] i.e., in legal retribution for murder. [259] i.e., that requiring the death penalty. [260] Or refrains from killing. [261] Heedless of Allāh's limits, negligent of their responsibilities.

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:32

Translation

Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

Original · Hebrew

הַ֭צֵּל לְקֻחִ֣ים לַמָּ֑וֶת וּמָטִ֥ים לַ֝הֶ֗רֶג אִם־תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ׃

Proverbs · 24:11

World English Bible

This verse does something strange with arithmetic. One life wrongly taken is as if all humanity were killed. One life saved is as if all were saved. That is not how counting works, and it is not meant to be. It says a person is not a fraction. No number of others can make one person cheap. Every tyrant's reasoning begins by treating people as a sum. This sentence refuses the sum, and it sets one rescuer's act on the same scale as the whole of humanity.

A question for you

Is there any number of lives that could justify sacrificing one innocent person?

If you sayNo.
ThenThen you are close to the weight this verse gives one life, and you will need an answer for those who ask about the hard cases.
If you saySometimes, in a terrible choice.
ThenMany moral traditions stumble here too. The verse does not remove the tragedy, but it keeps the weight.
If you sayI do not know.
ThenThat is a fair answer to one of the hardest questions there is.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,[675] then fall down to him in prostration."

Translator's notes

[675] The element of life and soul which Allāh created for that body, not His own spirit or part of Himself (as some mistakenly believe).

Quran · Al-Hijr 15:29

Translation

Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

Original · Hebrew

וַיִּיצֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וַיִּפַּ֥ח בְּאַפָּ֖יו נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים וַֽיְהִ֥י הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּֽה׃

the Torah (Genesis) · 2:7

World English Bible

One line goes further than honour. In the account of the first human, God says He shaped him and breathed into him of His spirit. Whatever that means, and the book says we are given little knowledge of the spirit (17:85), it places in a person something that did not come from the dust. This is why a human being is more than what they weigh. It is also a reason for hope on the worst days: nothing in the verse says this can be taken from you.

A question for you

What would change if you saw people this way, yourself among them?

If you sayHow I speak to some of them.
ThenThen the next conversation is already in your hands.
If you sayIt is hard to see myself this way.
ThenYou are not alone in that. The honour in the verse does not depend on your feeling it.
If you saySome days I do not feel my life is worth living.
ThenThis app cannot hear you or reach anyone for you, so please do not carry this alone. Talk today to someone you trust, a doctor, or a helpline where you live, and if you are in danger now, reach for the nearest person who can help. The honour in the verse has not changed.
